about: Cabinet „Solicitările mele” row (2026-10-20: the act row of js/act-row.js with the request's content) vs the „Actele mele permisive” act row. a = pp-01 (act „Cafeneaua „Izvoraș”” — Valabil, green Small tag), b = sm-01 (request „Cantina „Nord”” — Finalizat, green Small tag; same tone so tag colours compare). Card box, title, tag, meta and a meta part must have 0 differences. Phones (action-menu-v1, 2026-10-20): ONE anatomy for both — row 1 = [icon ·] tags · the action button right (library btn-neutral btn-sm, square: requests „Acțiuni ⌄”, acts „Postprocese ⌄” — under the meta when it does not fit), title 16/24 at every width, row 2 = title 16/24, row 3 = meta; the action button is a compared pair (same class, size, colours, radius 6). Run: node --experimental-websocket --no-warnings tools/ui-qa/compare-styles.mjs --a pp-01 --b sm-01 --spec tools/ui-qa/specs/cabinet-request-row-vs-act-row.json --viewports 1440,375,320 Ignored (content, not style): the action column width (grid-template-columns) and the right edges of title / meta (text length). Request rows have NO lead icon (user 2026-10-20), so the text starts at the card padding: title / meta rect.x are ignored (12 vs 48) and the icon pair is gone. Notice = the act row's locked notice (Laborator, warning) vs the request „Informații suplimentare” alert (warning).

expected.name: meta part
expected.why: content: the request's 2nd meta part (process · service name) is longer than the act's and wraps to 2 lines in the 254 text width at 320

expected.name: action button
expected.why: placement by fit (js/act-row.js syncActionFit): at 320 the act's long „Postprocese ⌄” does not fit next to the tags → under the meta, left (.is-action-below); the request's short „Acțiuni ⌄” stays on row 1, right. Same class / size / colours / radius.
